name: claude-mods
description: Mods for Claude Code: plugins of function hooks that change how long work runs.

plugins.name: smart-compact
plugins.description: Lets Claude compact its own context at a step boundary it picks, with its own instructions, then resume the work.

plugins.name: gh-pane
plugins.description: A docked pane of the session repo's issues and PRs in run order, with buttons that fill the next command, plus two for this session's ship runs: send the merge reply at the merge gate, then, once the PR is merged there or by ship on its own, clear and run the next command.
